verdict.rationale: uv can pin a Python version per directory (`uv python pin` writes `.python-version`), and `uv run` picks up the project environment when a command is invoked. That is invocation-time resolution, an adjacent behavior, not activation of tool versions on directory entry. No evidence shows a shell hook that activates on `cd` or any loading of project environment variables, so the story's capability is not evidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the right tool versions and environment variables activate automatically when I enter a project directory
